values.title: Reno County Elections 1

settings.markdown:
Voting in Reno County

Local election information at your fingertips
Who are My Elected Representatives and how can I obtain Representative District Boundary Maps?

Find out who your representatives are and how to contact them.


Launch the Locate My Representative App

Download maps of the Reno County Commission or Hutchinson City Council districts here.  School district boundary maps, precinct maps, and township maps are also available for download.
Download Representative District and Other Helpful Maps

Voting Locations

Want to cast your vote early or learn where to vote on Election Day?

Where to go for in-person advance voting or to drop off a mail-in ballot?

In-person advance voting for the upcoming November 4th General Election begins October 20, 2025 and will end at noon on November 3, 2025.  In-person advance voting is held at the:
Reno County Courthouse Annex
125 W 1st Ave
Hutchinson, KS 67501
Mail-in ballots can be dropped off at the drop box in front of the main entrance of the Courthouse Annex.

Where to vote on Election Day?

The Election Polling Places application helps you locate a polling place where ballots can be cast here in Reno County on Election Day. You will also be able to see which voter precinct you are located in.

Launch the Find My Precinct and Polling Place App   ↗

Key 2025 General Election Dates

  • Advance ballots will be mailed out beginning October 15th.
  • In-person advance voting will begin at the Annex on October 20th.
  • The deadline to Register to Vote is October 14th.
  • The last day to request a mail ballot is October 28th.

  • In-person advance voting ends at noon on November 3rd.
  • Election Day is November 4th until 7 pm.

Election Results

Explore results for current and past elections.

Explore Results

Election Information

Answers to frequently asked questions on voting in Kansas and Reno County are available here.
